Population increased in Winchester

The estimated population of Winchester in 2024 was 135,632 usual residents, a rise of 1.8% since 2023.

This meant that Winchester's rate of population change placed it among the 20 percent fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Winchester increased by 6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Winchester was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Winchester

The average (median) age fell to 42.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Winchester has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Winchester is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Winchester's population of 135,632 usual residents was made up of:

  • 24,449 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18%)
  • 82,671 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61%)
  • 28,512 people aged 65 years and over, (21%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Winchester has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Winchester, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Winchester
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Winchester, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 4 people (0%). In total, there were 1,177 births and 1,181 deaths in Winchester.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,276 (1%). There were 11,834 people entering the area and 10,558 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Winchester's population of 914 (0.7%) as a result of 1,840 people entering the area and 926 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Winchester was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Winchester in mid-2023 is 133,253.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 494 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 319 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 813 people.
